<strong>El integral quita el error perma: The integral term removes the standing error; the derivative term, the overshoot. If a question says “it always falls short”, the integral term is missing; if it says “it oscillates on arrival”, there is too much proportional or too little derivative.
<strong>La variedad se cuenta, no se est: Variety is counted, not estimated. The number of states of the system against the number of states of the regulator: if the regulator has fewer, there are disturbances it cannot compensate, and saying it that way is the answer.
<strong>Sigue el signo alrededor del buc: Follow the sign around the loop. A loop with an even number of inversions is positive feedback and runs away; with an odd number, negative, and it corrects itself. Counting signs answers many questions with no arithmetic at all.
<strong>Un retardo no cambia la ganancia: A delay does not change the gain, it changes the phase. That is what turns a controller that worked into one that oscillates, and it is the block's favourite trap.
Aplicar la regla de un autómata celular: Applying the rule of a cellular automaton and predicting the pattern; identifying the five systems of the viable system model and what fails if one is missing; deciding what changes when the observer enters the system.
Cada tramo aporta un número fijo de preg: Each section contributes a fixed number of questions, drawn at random from its topics without repeating a topic while that is possible, and avoiding the most basic exercises. Las conferencias Macy reunieron entre 19: The Macy conferences brought together mathematicians, engineers, psychologists and anthropologists between 1946 and 1953 to find what a thermostat, a neuron and a society had in common. There was no textbook and no examination: they argued. Out of those meetings came the word “cybernetics” and almost every topic in this block, and the question that organised them is the one that organises this exam: what it takes for something to keep itself going.
Más ganancia proporcional, para que empu: More proportional gain, so that it pushes harder
Quince temas que juntan la derivada, la: Fifteen topics that bring together the derivative, entropy, probability and dynamical systems to answer a single question: how anything stays where it should in a world that pushes it. This topic teaches nothing new: it asks. A procedural exam with exercises from the whole block, with a clock and no hints.
Reduce el error pero no lo elimina, y pa: It reduces the error but does not remove it, and past a certain point it makes the system oscillate. The standing error is structural to proportional control, not a question of strength.
Separar señal de ruido con una media móv: Separating signal from noise with a moving average or an exponential filter; one iteration of the Kalman filter in one dimension; what a perceptron can separate and what it cannot; updating MENACE's weights after a game.
Un error constante que no desaparece es: A constant error that will not go away is the signature of purely proportional control: it needs an error in order to act. The integral term adds that error up over time until the action is enough and the error reaches zero.
Un examen de bloque es un simulacro hech: A block exam is a mock paper taken at home: with a clock, no notes and no hints. The questions come from the exercises of the 15 topics of the block, spread across sections, and every time you start one the numbers are different and so are the topics: doing it several times covers the whole block. On submission everything is marked, the step-by-step solution of each question opens, and the mark comes out section by section, with links to what is worth revising. The “tailored to what you have done” option puts first what you have not solved yet: it is the way to check that no topic is left untouched.
Un termostato mantiene la temperatura do: A thermostat keeps the temperature two degrees below the set point, always. What is the controller missing?
